Subject: Request: certification and snapshot of LLM handling of customer data

Hi Sofia,

We are starting our vendor privacy assessment for a new AI-enabled product and need a short-form certification that Redwood does not train models on customer prompt/response data for customers who have opted out, plus a snapshot of your retention policy for prompts, embeddings, and operator logs. Our legal team also asks for an exported mapping of SOC 2 / SIG controls that correspond to those commitments (so we can include the mapping in our external DPA addendum).

Required by: Oct 12, 2026 (internal deadline).
Requested deliverables:
- A one-page attestation stating default training behavior and opt-out mechanics.
- Retention snapshot (fields retained, default retention durations, presence of ephemeral caches).
- SOC2/SIG mapping sheet for ingestion/training and logging controls.

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? If you prefer, I can open a shared workspace for evidence.

Thanks,

Sofia / Marissa — attaching the artifacts Novamed requested and a short explanatory note. See attachments: redwood-privacy-snapshot-20261007.pdf (one-page attestation + retention table) and SOC2-SIG-mapping-llm.xlsx (control mapping).

Summary (for Sofia to pass on to Lauren):
- Training on customer prompt/response data: Redwood does not use customer prompts/responses to update or retrain hosted model weights by default. Customers may opt in to allow training in explicit contracts; opt-out is the default for hosted customers.
- Opt-out mechanics: Customers can flag "no-train" at account level in the Console; for Dedicated/Private deployments, a contractual clause plus configuration ensures no external training.
- Retention: default application logs and request/response transcripts are retained for 30 days for debugging and SLO analysis, after which records are removed from hot stores and archived per DPA exceptions. Embeddings are retained per customer config (usually 90 days by default) unless customer requests shorter retention. KV cache used for live sessions is ephemeral and not persisted beyond session expiry unless explicitly saved.
- Evidence: the PDF contains a signed attestation line, the mapping workbook cross-references SOC2 trust services criteria to SIG/CAIQ where relevant.

Attachments: [redwood-privacy-snapshot-20261007.pdf] (signature: Marissa Cole, Head of Compliance)
[ SOC2-SIG-mapping-llm.xlsx ]
